main_text.l: lis ulli eo nomine mota est, nec
peritis ac veris Theologis, quia non hominum,
sed Dei doctrina est in verbo
à nobis ostendi potest. Nec puto
nostras, & sic novam doctrinam illis obtrudere conetur,
nisi frontem plane perfricuerit. Non tamen desunt
neq;[?] soli injurii videantur in unctos
tire. Ita Stapletonus & alii Pontificii Angli, Lutherum,
Melancbtonem, Calvinum in suas partes pertrahere
esse[?] calumniam, quâ in sequiorem sensum

page.notes: Words marked [?] are abbreviation marks I could not fully resolve: "invehere" followed by a curved mark, "neq;" after "Primò enim,", and "esse" followed by a curved mark. "Stapletonus" is printed in a ligature and may be misread. "sensum" is split across the line end without a printed hyphen and is written whole. The "Digitized by Google" banner at the lower right is excluded.
